page.overview:
Who is Lavender Fritter?

Lavender Fritter is a female Earth pony and member of the Apple family. She has a light yellow coat, two-tone purple mane and tail, green eyes, and a cutie mark of three apple fritters. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise.

Lavender Fritter is identical to Apple Fritter in all but mane color, and she has the same design as Jonagold, S04E26 Unnamed Earth Mare #1, "Raspberry Glaze", S05E06 Unnamed Earth Mare #10, and S05E06 Unnamed Earth Mare #15.

In season two, Lavender Fritter appears in the Sisterhooves Social crowd in Sisterhooves Social and at Mare Do Well's thank-you parade near the end of The Mysterious Mare Do Well (without her bows and the ends of her pigtails).

In season three, Lavender Fritter watches Twilight Sparkle's magical demonstration for the Saddle Arabia delegates at the end of Magic Duel.
